senses.gloss: --the name of a hell. Br. IV. 2. १५०.
--experts in astrology predicted परी- क्षित्'s future glory at the time of his birth. भा. I. १६. 1; cf. I. १२. १५-29.

(I)--an auspicious hour between 1--2 p.m. midday time:
1: भा. III. १८. २७; VII. १०. ६७.
best for gifts.
2: M. २२. 2.

(II)--the २८थ् naks2atra on the right nostril of शिशुमार;
1: भा. V. २२. ११; २३. 6; वा. ५०. १३०; ८२. १२; ९६. २०१.
the नक्षत्र of कृष्ण.
2: भा. VIII. १८. 5; Br. III. ७१. २०५.
Identified with Hari.
3: भा. XI. १६. २७.
(III)--A son of Andhaka, (आनकदुन्धुभि- वि। प्।), and father of Punarvasu. Br. III. ७१. ११९; Vi. IV. १४. १४.
(I)--आर्षेयप्रवर (अङ्गिरस्). M. १९६. 6.
(II)--(Punarvasu) the son of Candanodaka- dundubhi; performed अश्वमेध. Father of twins, आहुक and आहुकि. वा. ९६. ११८, १२०; Br. III, ७१. ११९-122.
--technique of dancing started by Bharata. M. २४. ३०.

--the son of Durdama or Durmada:
1: Br. III. ७१. १७१.
of the रोहिणि family.
2: वा. ९६. १६९.
[page१-079+ ३२]

(I)--a son of Arjuna and सुभद्रा. Wife उत्तरा. Conqueror of अतिरथस्।
1: भा. IX. २२. ३३. Br. III. ७१. १७८; M. ५०. ५६; Vi. IV. २०. ५१;
Famous for valour even as a boy. Father of परीक्षित्.
2: भा. I. 4. 9. Vi. IV. २०. ५२.
द्रौणि wanted to destroy his seed in embryo. कृष्ण frustrated this attempt. Taken by कृष्ण to द्वारक.
4: Ib. X. ६४ [११].
Slew बृहद्बल in the भारत war.
4: (a) Vi. IV. 4, ११२.
Went with कृष्ण to उपप्लाव्य to see the पाण्ड- vas.
5: भा. X. ७८. [१६ (V) 4].
Killed by Saindhava.
6: Ib. X. ७८. [३०].
A रथी;
7: वा. ९६. १७६; ९९. २४९.
considered as god.
8: वा. ३१. 7.
^3) भा. III. 3. १७.
(III)--a sage of the second सावर्ण epoch. Br. IV. 1. ७१.
(IV)--a son of Manu and नड्वला. Vi. I. १३. 5.
--(Rudra) entered आत्मन् (अहङ्कार) of विराट् पुरुष। भा. III. 6. २५.
--one of the names in the second मरुत् गण। वा. ६७. १२५.
--one of the names in the third मरुत् गण। वा. ६७. १२६.
--a मरुत् of the third गण। Br. III. 5. ९५. [page१-080+ २६]
--a class of people in कुशद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १६.
--a northern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ४८.

--The anointing ceremony: when Puru, the last son was recommended by ययाति, the people said that it was धर्म to anoint the eldest; defined the law that the faithful son alone was fit for the throne; Puru having fulfilled his father's wishes was to be regarded the faithful and dutiful; this was agreed to; further it was endorsed by शुक्र. वा. ९३. ७६-87; ९९. ४५१.
--of राम, described. Vi. IV. 4. ९८-99.

--Incantations done by पुरोहित and ministers for defeating the enemy--according to भण्ड;
1: Br. IV. २१. ९७.
Brhaspati did this on behalf of Indra to vanquish राजि's sons.
2: Vi. IV. 9. १९.
--a महारथ, and a commander of भण्ड's army. His riding vehicle was Simha. Br. IV. २९. २१-2.

--country of आभीरस्.
1: भा. I. १०. ३५; Br. II. १६. ४६ and ५७; १८. ४८.
Dvijas of, became व्रात्यस् after Puramjaya's days.
2: भा. XII 1. ३८.
Purified of sin by devotion to Hari.
3: Ib. II. 4. १८.
Seven of this tribe ruled from अवभृति.
4: भा. XII. 1. २९; वा. ९९. ३५९; Vi. IV. २४. ५१, ६८.
The ब्रःमाण्ड and वायु say ten of them ruled after the आन्ध्रस्;
5: Br. III. ७४. १७४; M. ५०. ७६; ११४. ४०; १६३. ७२; २७३. १८.
for ६७ years. [page१-165+ ३०]

--a tribe of दक्षिणापथ saw Arjuna singly carrying much wealth and women and attacked him; he took up his गाण्डिव and found he had lost its secret and power;
1: वा. ४५. ११५, १२६; ४७. ४६; ९९. २६९; Vi. II. 3. १६.
freebooters and shepherds of the पञ्चनद country who lived in villages; म्लेच्छस्; chief weapons of, staves and cudgels.
2: Vi. V. ३८. १४-28, ५०-52.
--observed the कल्याणिनी व्रतम् and became उर्वशी of the Heaven. M. ६९. ५९.
